premises.text: College students cannot get on-demand help, form study groups, or share resources easily, widening the achievement gap
premises.evidence_span: It's really hard for students to master a topic if they can't get help on demand. It's hard to find study groups if students cannot easily share knowledge or resources

premises.text: School-email signup connects students to classmates for course discussions, collaborative study guides, and free shared files across sections/semesters
premises.evidence_span: any student can easily access the brainpower and knowledge of their entire class right on our platform

premises.text: Growth uses campus founders and first-day marketing, then student invites (student-first, not university sales)
premises.evidence_span: we put together a campus founder program, and we do a big marketing and social media push the first day of class. After that, it's the students inviting their classmates

premises.text: A peer mentor program offers affordable on-demand one-on-one tutoring from platform-identified top students on course pages
premises.evidence_span: we're going to allow every single college student to offer online, on-demand tutoring sessions and make some money while helping others

premises.text: Platform data on when and which subject students need help enables highly targeted mentor matching
premises.evidence_span: we know exactly when they need help. We know exactly the subject they need help with, and that allows us to be highly targeted like no other

value.text: On-demand peer learning help so college students can master coursework and close achievement gaps
value.evidence_span: the social learning platform for college students

secondary_value.text: Peer mentors earn money while helping classmates
secondary_value.evidence_span: a way for students to make some money for college and a way for every single college student to get personalized one-on-one help

causal_links.evidence_span: Students learn best by helping each other out
get personalized one-on-one help right when they need it

notes: Help/study-group/resource pains folded as one student problem set. Collaborative guides/files/sections treated as facets of one class social platform. Peer mentor + targeting data treated as separately revisable tutoring marketplace layer; campus founder GTM as growth condition. 40k student beta metrics excluded as traction. Q&A partnership answer after pitch closing excluded per §4.2.5. Singleton D2 retained as core product module.
